cases.sentence: Все разделяют одну ___ праведник и нечестивый.
cases.translation: Both the righteous and the wicked share one fate.
cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "разделяют" (share) requires the Accusative case.

cases.translation: The hearts of people are full of evil and madness.
cases.explain: After the noun "сердца" (hearts), the possessor is in the Genitive case.
Direct object of the transitive verb "имеет" (has) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Даже живой ___ лучше, чем мертвому льву.
cases.translation: Even a living dog is better than a dead lion.
cases.explain: After the comparison, use the Dative case.

cases.sentence: Мертвые не знают ничего и уже не будет им ___.
cases.translation: The dead know nothing and will have no reward.
cases.explain: After the verb "не будет" (there will not be), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Итак, иди и ешь со своей ___ с удовольствием.
cases.translation: Go eat with your wife with pleasure.
cases.explain: After the preposition "со" (with), use the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В мире мертвых нет ни работы, ни ___.
cases.translation: In the world of the dead, there is no work or kind.
cases.explain: After "ни" (nor) with negation, use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Человек не знает, когда придет его ___.
cases.translation: A man does not know when his hour will come.
cases.explain: Subject of the verb "придет" (will come) is in the Nominative case.

reading.ru: Все разделяют одну участь, праведник и нечестивый, добрый и злой.
reading.question: What do both the righteous and wicked share?
reading.explain: All share one fate, righteous and wicked, good and evil.

reading.ru: Сердца людей полны зла и безумия, пока они живы, а после они отходят к умершим.
reading.question: What characterizes people's hearts while alive?
options: They are full of evil and madness
reading.correct: They are full of evil and madness
reading.explain: The hearts of men are full of evil and madness while they live.

reading.ru: Даже живой собаке лучше, чем мертвому льву.
reading.question: What comparison is made?
options: A living lion is better than a dead dog
A dead dog is better than a living lion
A living dog is better than a dead lion
reading.correct: A living dog is better than a dead lion
reading.explain: A living dog is better than a dead lion.

reading.ru: Живые знают, что умрут, а мертвые ничего не знают, и уже не будет им награды.
reading.question: What do the living know that the dead do not?
options: That they will die, and the dead know nothing and have no reward
reading.correct: That they will die, and the dead know nothing and have no reward
reading.explain: The living know they will die, but the dead know nothing.

reading.ru: Все, что ты в силах делать, делай, потому что в мире мертвых нет ни работы, ни размышления, ни знания, ни мудрости.
reading.question: Why should one do all that they can?
options: Because in the world of the dead there is no work or wisdom
reading.correct: Because in the world of the dead there is no work or wisdom
reading.explain: In the world of the dead there is no work or wisdom.
